business_problem: The demand for PTHB’s services has increased significantly over the years as they’ve dealt with evolving healthcare needs and population growth. As new patients enter the national healthcare system, so does the rise in data captured about the patient, hospital operations and more.
solution_summary: Powys Teaching Health Board built its Databricks implementation around Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Assistant, Lakehouse Federation. The demand for PTHB’s services has increased significantly over the years as they’ve dealt with evolving healthcare needs and population growth. As new patients enter the national healthcare system, so does the rise in data captured about the patient, hospital operations and more. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Databricks Assistant helps practitioners accelerate code, query, and troubleshooting work inside the Databricks workspace. Lakehouse Federation lets teams query remote systems alongside lakehouse data without copying all source data first.

It connects with Power BI, Power Apps, BigQuery.
